additional_info.subject: RE: 0373577 - ID0373577-DC/Si-D/FR-[3gy1Xm] ERR_SCH_RAMPDOWNVOLT CRM:00658000687
additional_info.body:
Hello Bastien,
Greetings of the day.
We have checked the logs of this charger for 1st July and can see that charging session stopped on Chademo with Error code 43.
This error only occurs when voltage of converters did not ramp down within time after charging session is finished.
In this chase charging session was stopped as either SECC or PLC got stuck.
As this incident is very old so it is not possible to get additional information.
This issue gets resolved by rebooting the charger.
Please let me know if you have any other question on this.
Awaiting your response.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Saurav
